See Guide to the Scriptures, “Bethlehem,” Gospel Library. Ephratah was a family name within the tribe of Judah and was the name of the region in which Bethlehem was located (see Kenneth L. Barker and others, eds.,NIV Study Bible: Fully Revised Edition[2020], 1555, note onMicah 5:2). Bethlehem was also where King David lived in his youth (see Bible Dictionary, “David”).
